Buyer questions

Frequently Asked Questions

01What is your minimum order quantity?

Our standard MOQ is approximately 700 pieces per style. Final feasibility depends on fabric, design, colour split and order requirements.

02What is your approximate price range?

Our approximate FOB positioning is USD 3–12 per piece, depending on style, fabric, workmanship, packing and order volume.

03Can you develop products from references or sketches?

Yes. We can evaluate buyer references, sketches or specifications for development, subject to technical feasibility and agreed ownership requirements.

04Can you source fabrics and trims?

Fabric and trim options can be reviewed against the design, season, sourcing conditions and quantity.

05What is your monthly production capacity?

ESHA Apparels has capacity of up to 250,000 pieces per month across two factories, supported by 575 sewing machines and subject to style mix and production planning.

06Can you handle repeat orders?

Repeat orders can be evaluated against fabric availability, line planning, approved specifications and the required delivery window.

07Do you manufacture buyer-exclusive styles?

Exclusive product development can be considered subject to a clear written agreement, commercial feasibility and ownership terms.

08What markets do you export to?

ESHA Apparels has international export experience, including the Japanese market. Additional verified markets will be added to this profile.

09How do you manage quality control?

Quality checkpoints cover fabric, pre-production review, in-line inspection, measurements, finishing, final inspection and packing verification.

10What information is required for costing?

Please share the product category, design direction, fabric or material notes where available, size range, quantity, colour split, packing and delivery requirements.

11Can buyers visit the factories?

Factory meeting requests can be reviewed in advance. Visit timing, location and access details are confirmed directly with ESHA Apparels.
